patches.notes: First patch through the launcher: proves the auto-updater works. Patches download by themselves from here on.

Roads: all 1,370 km of the Tweed's real roads (OpenStreetMap), cut and filled into the terrain. Cracked old bitumen, faded line markings, gravel shoulders, kerbs and footpaths in town, dirt farm tracks, bridges with barriers and piers, grass and moss creeping back in. Creative / survival mode (Esc menu): Forge only in creative. Forge gets Weapons, Car parts, Tools, Survival, World and Nature tabs with ~100 new Poly Haven scans plus four engines (Holden 202, Toyota 22R, Ford 351 Cleveland, Jeep 4.0) with bolt-on alternators. Cars and props left far away no longer fall through the world.
Updater upgrade: lets the launcher download big updates in pieces. If the next update shows a download error, close the game and open it again.
Updater fix: no time limit on big downloads.

Big one. Simulated driving: real engine torque curves, auto and manual boxes, clutch, diffs (open / LSD / locked), raycast suspension with springs, dampers, bump stops and sway bars, Pacejka tyres; you can watch the shocks, springs, leaf packs, wishbones and sway bars work under the car. Engine sounds synthesised for the 202, 22R, 351 Cleveland and Jeep 4.0, with crackle on lift-off and the starter. Zombies (slow, arms out, they hit hard) and scavs (patrol, suspicion, whistle alarm, they shoot back). Ragdolls, limbs and heads come off, blood, run them over. Six period guns (Lee-Enfield, SLR, Colt Python, side-by-side, sawn-off, 870 pump) held in your hands, aim down the sights with right mouse. Garage (Esc menu, creative): build a vehicle from any cab on a ladder chassis, pick engine, box, axles, springs, travel, damping, tyres, add a third axle, save and drive it. Scanned grass up close. Credits page.

Animation overhaul: every character now shares one humanoid skeleton, so 50+ clips play on any body. New rifle animations (idle, walk, run, crouch, reload), body turns to follow where you look after ~70 degrees (35 with a gun up), head and spine look where the camera looks, legs swing toward the way you're walking. Hands properly on the gun in first and third person (right hand on the grip, left under the fore-end). Scopes on the Lee-Enfield (3.5x) and SLR (4x): aim to get a magnified scope window. Five new zombie models with real zombie walks, idles, attacks, bites and a scream when they spot you. 14 scav camps across the map (fire, shelters, barricades, a wreck, loot, a sentry on the gate). Zombies now wander in along the roads, out of sight, instead of fixed spawns.

F9 bug report: grabs a screenshot and the whole game state (where you are, what you're driving or holding, nearby zombies and scavs, settings, frame rate, recent log), pauses, and lets you type what happened. Save it as a zip, or Send it straight to a private GitHub repo for Claude to read.
Fix: keys added in updates (F9 bug report, fire, aim, reload, weapon slots, holster) weren't being registered on installed copies. They are now.
F9 bug report box now sits in the middle of the screen, so the Send button and token box are visible.

Inventory (I): Unturned-style grid with shaped items, worn clothes and bags add pockets, guns load from carried rounds; F opens crates, ammo boxes and other props; MMB carry, RMB throw; B bandage. HUD health and ammo fixed. New PBR ground at real scale, BlendKit lawn, Poly Haven grass clumps everywhere. Water ripple grid fixed. Iron sights measured from each gun (no more rifles in your face), revolver turned the right way round. Mid-air leg pose. Zombies quieter, no more floor-eating attack. Tyres: grip by ground type, slide falloff, tyre pressure, deflection, smoke, rubber marks, screech, dirt spray; Globe mags in the garage. Cars no longer get stuck on corpses.

Roads round the pub and down Tweed Valley Way past the gallery rebuilt with a node road generator from real map data: proper roundabout with a kerbed island, junctions, and the overtaking lane south of the gallery. Inventory items now have pictures that fill their grid shape (rifles long, pistols short). Engine sounds re-recorded from a real engine simulator. Less blue tint on roads and pale ground; matte ground textures.
Fixes the crash on Play from 0.2.11 (a road texture was missing from the build). The game now also starts without the new roads if they ever fail to load.

full.notes: First Godot build with the launcher built in. Pause menu with graphics settings, Forge mode with phys gun and terrain sculpting, 27 drivable bodies, 52 props, your survivor as a full body, cab view and hop-out fixes.
